topic: The Hidden Symmetry: From Ternary Counting to Sierpinski Fractals
target_audience: University students (Computer Science or Mathematics majors)

sections.title: The Bridge: From Binary to Ternary Counting
lecture_lines: Base-3 digits represent distinct three-way branch choices.
Each digit dictates one specific path at every junction.
Ternary counting naturally generates recursive, branching structures.
animations: Display binary digits '0', '1', '2' in light blue (#ADD8E6) centered around a [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/junction.svg].
Transition '2' to '0' while highlighting the carry bit in yellow (#FFFF00) at the [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/junction.svg].
Group binary digits to show transition to ternary base in green (#90EE90) originating from the [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/junction.svg].

sections.title: The Constrained Towers of Hanoi
lecture_lines: Disks move only between adjacent pegs in this variation.
Each move state maps uniquely to a ternary string.
Three disks create twenty-seven possible state configurations.
animations: Animate moving [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/disk.svg] from [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/peg.svg] A to B using arc path.
Highlight illegal move restriction in red (#FF6347).

sections.title: Visualizing the State Space: The Sierpinski Triangle
lecture_lines: Projecting move-states reveals the Sierpinski Triangle structure.
Small disk structures nest within larger recursive patterns.
The optimal solution path traces the fractal edges.
animations: Start with a single triangle in white (#FFFFFF) resembling the shape of [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/disk.svg].
Add three smaller triangles iteratively in blue (#00BFFF).
Fill the Sierpinski pattern showing depth 3 in light grey (#D3D3D3) using the base structure from [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/disk.svg].

sections.title: Synthesis: Decoding the Fractal
lecture_lines: Ternary strings serve as addresses in the fractal geometry.
Recursive counting perfectly maps to nested spatial structures.
Geometry emerges directly from the structure of recursive logic.
animations: Show path traversing the Sierpinski triangle in purple (#9370DB).
Overlay binary counting sequence onto triangle nodes in yellow (#FFFFE0).
Highlight total moves formula as N=3^k in light cyan (#E0FFFF).
